subject: Private/VPC pilot coordination — St Augustine Health
messages:
From: Julia Morales <julia.morales@staugustinehealth.org>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Private deployment / pilot for inference

Hi Connor,

Thanks — we self-registered for a Private/VPC trial on your site and my security team flagged a few follow-ups. We're evaluating vendors for an on-prem or VPC-hosted inference path for PHI workloads. Would like a short demo and to discuss evidence and timeline for a pilot.

Key context:
- Organization: St Augustine Health (multi-clinic network)
- Initial use-case: clinical summarization + internal search (PHI)
- Compliance bar: SOC 2 + documented retention controls

Can you send a few slots next week? I'll loop in Alex (infra) and our security lead if you can share a quick pre-demo checklist.

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Morales
Director of Clinical Systems
St Augustine Health
julia.morales@staugustinehealth.org
+1 (415) 555-0193

- Tue Jun 15 — 10:00–10:40 AM
- Wed Jun 16 — 2:00–2:40 PM

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Private deployment / pilot for inference

Thanks Julia — Wed Jun 16 at 4:00 PM PDT works for our team. I've scheduled a 40-minute slot and included a brief agenda below.

Attendees we have added: Soojin Lee (Solutions Architect) and Priyom Das (Sales Ops / procurement). Please confirm Alex and your security lead.

Quick answers:
- On-prem air-gapped: we support an on-prem package for pilots, but it requires extra lead time (license + ops runbook). We can cover the high-level feasibility in the demo and follow up with a scoped runbook if you decide to proceed.
- SOC 2 evidence: sharing a redacted snapshot for intake now (attached). We will provide more formal artifacts during procurement under an NDA.

Agenda (40m):
1) 5m — Intros & objectives
2) 15m — Platform architecture & deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private / on-prem)
3) 15m — Pilot plan & timeline (data handling, retention, telemetry)
4) 5m — Next steps & prep for procurement

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=staugustine-private-pilot
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/7421/contact/58723

Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf

Looking forward — see you Wed at 4pm.

Best,
Connor

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Julia Morales <julia.morales@staugustinehealth.org>, Alex Santos <alex.santos@staugustinehealth.org>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Prep for Wed demo — items to have ready

Hi Julia / Alex — thanks for confirming the Wed slot. A few items that will make the 40-minute discussion as productive as possible: 

- If you can share a short diagram of your network/VPC boundaries (redacted is fine) so we can quickly align on connectivity options.
- Any compliance policy that defines retention, re-identification protections, or required audit logs.
- List of stakeholder emails for follow-up (security, legal, procurement) so we can loop them into the procurement playbook.

We'll cover the on-prem feasibility at a high level and can follow up with an ops runbook and timeline. If you prefer an NDA before we send more artifacts, we can route a standard mutual NDA via DocuSign quickly.

Drive prep doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-private-pilot
DocuSign NDA (optional): https://app.docusign.com/s/ndastub

See you Wed — cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com
